name: Control-power fuse-failure aggregation
summary: Collects the assigned control-circuit fuse alarms into a common station indication.
description: Collects the assigned control-circuit fuse alarms into a common station indication. Control power supplies the command, protection and indication equipment associated with a switchgear assembly. The drawing must distinguish the source, each distribution branch and the functions lost if that branch fails.

In a switchgear lineup, separate protected branches may feed trip coils, closing coils and protection electronics. Their alarm contacts help the station controller identify which operating capability is unavailable. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Individual fuse alarms” at the input and “Common control-power alarm” at the output. Individual branch identification should remain available.

Follow the actual positive, negative or neutral returns and the protective device on each branch. A healthy voltage indication does not establish that every downstream path can deliver its required operating current. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
